data.body: **[P2] Keep other permanent path failures out of transient retries.** The symlink check bypasses this catch, but structural failures such as `NotDirectoryException` or `AccessDeniedException` from an invalid base-path component are still wrapped as retryable (and reads do the same). `RetrySerDes` then repeatedly delays for a configuration failure, and step retry handling may re-run user code after result serialization fails. Map known structural/permission failures to plain `SerDesException`, reserve retryability for genuinely transient availability failures, and add a non-directory-base regression test.
